description: Keyword search over the 39 Lithuanian guides on buhalteris.ai about small partnerships (mažoji bendrija, MB), individual activity (individuali veikla, IV), business certificates (verslo liudijimas), VAT (PVM), income tax (GPM), the tax-free amount (NPD), health and social insurance (PSD, VSD), founding a company, bank accounts and accounting prices. Query in Lithuanian for the best match; diacritics and word endings do not matter ("mokesciai" finds "mokesčių"). It matches words in the title, description, summary and FAQ questions; it is not a semantic search. Returns each guide's URL, summary, checked date, status and primary sources, best match first. status is "patikrinta" (checked against the sources), "atnaujinama" (being updated) or "hipotezė" (a hypothesis, not confirmed). Read the full text with get_guide.

limit.description: How many results to return at most. Omitted: 5. There is no upper bound; a number above the match count returns every match.

query.description: Keywords, for example "PVM registracija MB" or "verslo liudijimas 2027". Words of one letter are ignored.

name: search_guides

checkedAt.description: Date the figures were last checked against the sources, YYYY-MM-DD.

markdownUrl.description: The full rendered page as Markdown.

score.description: Match score; higher is better. Comparable only within one result list.

sources.description: Primary sources (VMI, Sodra, legal acts) behind the figures.

status.description: status is "patikrinta" (checked against the sources), "atnaujinama" (being updated) or "hipotezė" (a hypothesis, not confirmed).

summary.description: The direct answer the page opens with (Lithuanian).

updatedAt.description: Date of the last edit, YYYY-MM-DD.

totalMatches.description: Guides that matched, before `limit` was applied.

url.description: The buhalteris.ai index of pages for agents.

title: Search buhalteris.ai guides (gidų paieška)
